slides.title: What happened, or *the story?*
slides.sub: A two-column exercise for a moment that still stings.

slides.title: Pick one moment
slides.body: Something from this week you keep replaying. A comment, a look, a text that never got an answer.

slides.title: Column one: the facts
slides.body: Only what a camera would have caught. Who said what. What happened next. No motives, no meanings.

slides.title: Column two: the story
slides.body: What you decided it meant. About them, about you, about where this is all going.

slides.title: Read them side by side
slides.body: Where did the story go further than the facts? The facts are fixed. The story is yours to check.
